name: totals_distribution_v1
description: Primary objective for the pm_run_env_sigma sweep: totals/run-margin distribution calibration (Phase 1 priority #5 of the MLB sim accuracy plan). No PIT/coverage metric exists in summarize_batch_eval.py yet, so mae_total_runs/mae_run_margin stand in as the measured proxy. ML brier is carried since it derives from the same run-scoring distribution; starter workload and HR brier are low-weight sanity terms so a totals win doesn't quietly regress the already-promoted Phase 1 #1/#3 fixes.
